# Support Policy Document 8 — Northwind

## Purpose
This document defines procedure 8 for the Northwind support desk. It exists to be
ingested by the Aegis pipeline as part of a ten-document concurrency test.

## Rule 8
When a request of category 8 is raised, the agent assigned must acknowledge it within
16 hours. If the acknowledgement window is missed, the request escalates to the
team lead and the SLA clock is paused pending review.

## Escalation
A request escalated under rule 8 requires a written reason on the case note before it
may be reassigned. Reassignment without a recorded reason is refused by the platform.

## Closure
A request under rule 8 may only be set to resolved once the customer has confirmed the
outcome and the audit trail carries the approving agent's identity.
